acceptanceCriteria: Precondition recorded first: V1-1337's prospective run reads 'improve' (authored excess lower bound above 2.5% and above the grep bot); if it reads 'kill' or 'inconclusive', this ticket closes with a recorded decision not to pursue that cites that run.

A labelled held-out set of (hunk, basis) support pairs from at least one non-Corvint repository is committed with its labelling protocol, labeller identity and partition before any rank statistic is computed on it.

Per-basis rank against K deterministic null spans seeded by patchSha256 and the BH-corrected per-hunk fraction at a stated q are computed on the held-out set, with K chosen so the minimum p-value 1/(K+1) is below the BH threshold for the set size, and compared with human labels (precision and recall of BH discoveries).

Outcome recorded in a build-log entry: either proposed CEM-V1 requirements for a consumer report axis (byte-identical across native and portable consumers, no verdict) or a decision not to pursue with the measured precision.
body: Source: docs/build-log/2026-10-11-cem-1-0-expert-panel.md ("Seeded K-null permutation rank is post-rc.3 pending a held-out set"; decision 0523 P0 ships the deterministic cyclic-shift null instead), V1-1268, and the V1-1268 disposition (docs/build-log/2026-10-16-cem-post-rc3-disposition.md, origin/main a0b4c4108). Item: per-basis specificity rank against K deterministic null spans seeded by patchSha256, with a BH-corrected per-hunk fraction, as a consumer report axis. Measurement that sets the gate: tools/cem-citation-baseline already runs a seeded derangement null (DCW-V0-053, N=200 per map, seed patchSha256); on the post-S3 corpus (docs/build-log/2026-10-13-v1-1278-post-s3-citation-baseline.md) authored excess is 1.94% [1.53%, 2.34%] against 67.1% for the grep bot; a per-hunk rank keeps per-observation null information the pooled excess discards, but whether it tracks real support needs labels. The item needs (a) V1-1337 to show authored citations beat mechanical producers and (b) external labelled data this repository cannot supply. No rc.3 artifact advertises it (grep recorded in the disposition entry).
title: cem/1.0: per-basis specificity rank against seeded null spans with a BH per-hunk fraction, gated on V1-1337 and a labelled held-out set
